The '''''Corellian Consort''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Space Rescue Corps/Legends|Space Rescue]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and was captained by [[Everik Dondarvan]]. The ship held the record for the highest number of successful operations (56), and the largest total persons rescued (543) record of any Rescue Corps craft.
